pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantā lābhino honti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.4: etarahi kho āvuso therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantā lābhino honti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.6: athakho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ etha amhepi bhaginiyo upasaṅkamatha mayaṃpi ovadissāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.7: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo yena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamiṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.8: upasaṅkamitvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.9: athakho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīnaṃ parittaṃyeva dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā divasaṃ tiracchānakathāya vītināmetvā uyyojesuṃ gacchatha bhaginiyoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.10: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavā etadavoca kacci bhikkhuniyo ovādo iddho ahosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.12: ayyā chabbaggiyā parittaṃyeva dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā divasaṃ tiracchānakathāya vītināmetvā uyyojesunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.13: athakho bhagavā tā bhikkhuniyo dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.14: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.15: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū paṭipucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.16: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ parittaṃyeva dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā divasaṃ tiracchānakathāya vītināmetvā uyyojethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhunīnaṃ parittaṃyeva dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā divasaṃ tiracchānakathāya vītināmetvā uyyojessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.20: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.28: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhunovādakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.32: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno bhikkhunovādakassa sammati so tuṇhassa

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.44.1: yo pana bhikkhu asammato bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.45: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
